description_en: Queries the list of sound code schedules
description_zh: 调用该接口查询声码排程列表
name: QuerySoundCodeScheduleList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回的语料条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Valid values: 1 to 10000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页。取值范围1~10,000，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

EndDate.description_en: The end date of the schedule

EndTime.description_en: The daily end time of the schedule
EndTime.description_zh: 排程每日结束工作时间

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the schedule was created

OpenType.description_en:
The open type of the schedule.

Internal (default): The value is INNER. Only devices within the instance where the schedule resides can request sound code decoding.

Public: The value is OPEN. You can configure a whitelist by sending emails to allow devices from other instances to request sound code decoding. The usage of cross-instance decoding is calculated under the instance where the sound code resides
OpenType.description_zh:
排程开放类型。

内部（默认）：取值为INNER，只允许排程所在实例下的设备请求声码解码。

公开：取值为OPEN，可以发送邮件的方式配置白名单，允许跨实例的设备请求声码解码，跨实例解码的用量计算在声码所在的实例下

ScheduleCode.description_en: The unique identifier of the schedule

StartDate.description_en: The start date of the schedule

StartTime.description_en: The daily start time of the schedule
StartTime.description_zh: 排程每日开始工作时间

PageSize.description_en: The number of schedule entries returned per page

Total.description_en: The total number of schedules returned
Total.description_zh: 查询返回的排程总条数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: sound code service has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
